items.title: 21.3 Reactions of Halogenoalkanes (halogenoalkanes ke reactions) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.3, printed pages 75-76.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes mein C-X bond polar hai, kyun ke carbon aur halogen ki electronegativity (bond ke electrons ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat) mein farq hai. C-X ka carbon electrophilic centre (electrons ka bhooka hissa) ban jata hai, jis par nucleophile (electron pair dene wala) attack (hamla) kar sakta hai. Doosra option yeh hai ke saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par base attack kare. In do options se halogenoalkanes ke do types ke reactions bante hain:
a) Woh reactions jin mein halogen ki jagah koi aur atom ya group aa jata hai (nucleophilic substitution, ya SN reactions).

blocks.alt: Nu- se delta+ carbon ki taraf curly arrow, aur C-X bond se X ki taraf curly arrow. Arrow ke baad Nu-C (baqi teen bonds ab doosri taraf) + X-. Labels: Attacking Nucleophile (attack karne wala nucleophile), substrate molecule, substituted product, leaving group.
blocks.caption: Nucleophilic substitution reaction (kitab ke PDF page 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: b) Woh reactions jin mein halogenoalkane se HX nikal jata hai (elimination, ya E reactions), aur alkene banti hai.

blocks.alt: Substrate ke do jure carbons, aik par H aur agle par X (dono dashed box mein), se alkene C=C + HX. Labels: Substrate Molecule, Alkene, Hydrogen Halide.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction (kitab ke PDF page 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Substitution mein ek cheez nikalti hai aur doosri us ki jagah le leti hai (X gaya, Nu aaya). Elimination mein do cheezein (H aur X) nikalti hain aur un ki jagah do carbons ke darmiyan double bond ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki do types kaun si hain, aur har ek mein kaun attack karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleophilic substitution, jis mein nucleophile δ+ carbon par attack karta hai; aur elimination, jis mein base saath wale carbon ke hydrogen par attack karta hai.

items: Polar C-X: δ+ carbon electrophilic hai.
Do types ke reactions: nucleophilic substitution (SN) aur elimination (E).
